items.title: ASX jumps to two-month high on US blue wave
items.summary: Technology stocks soared more than 10 per cent as the ASX 200 closed at its highest level in two months, after a decisive Democrat election win rattled global markets.

items.title: Stocks crater as midterms spur investor exodus from tech and AI
items.summary: Tech-heavy Nasdaq plunges nearly 1,300 points as Wall Street weighs the impact of Democratic wins on the AI sector.

items.title: Woodside to axe 500 jobs, sparking fears for WA workers
items.summary: Gas giant Woodside Energy announces it will slash at least 500 jobs from its global workforce as part of plans to cut costs by $550 million a year from 2028.

aus.headline: ASX Hits Two-Month High
aus.body: Tech shares rose more than 10% and the ASX 200 ended the day at a two-month high.
aus.why: A US election result rippled straight into Australian share prices.

us.headline: Nasdaq Dives In Tech Rout
us.body: The Nasdaq fell almost 1,300 points as traders weighed Democratic wins on AI firms.
us.why: Big swings on Wall Street often set the tone for the ASX next day.

biz.headline: Woodside To Cut 500 Jobs
biz.body: Woodside plans to cut at least 500 jobs worldwide to save $550m a year from 2028.
biz.why: The cuts have sparked fears for workers in Western Australia.
